svg.title: Prepare a new user-service unit file.
svg.desc: A unit is an object managed by systemd. A service unit file configures a program's command and startup rules. The example needs a reachable user manager, nano, /usr/bin/python3, a dedicated web-demo directory and an unused local port 8000. The directory contains only public-to-local-users demo files, with no private files or links to them. The new file belongs in the user's systemd configuration directory; the adjacent warning prevents overwriting an existing service. Stop the foreground demo first.
svg.text: A unit is an object systemd manages. A service unit describes a program's rules.
Needs: working user manager, nano, /usr/bin/python3, unused port 8000.
Prepared ~/web-demo/index.html: the local demo page. ~ means your home.
Serve only that demo directory; no private files or links to them.
Stop the foreground demo with Ctrl-C first: port 8000 must be free.
WARNING: use a new unit name; don't overwrite an existing service.
This directory holds your user units. Save the next page's configuration here.
Confirm /usr/bin/python3 exists; this example uses that exact program path.
